stages.name: Straight
hint: The wind turns once per beat: the dot shows where it is blowing. The boat is moored.
Hold Space to raise the sail while the dot is in the green; let go when it enters the red.
Do it on every turn: the arrow shows the push you get, towards the middle of the green.

stages.name: Left
hint: The green has moved to the left. The wind gets there a quarter turn earlier.
Raise the sail earlier, while the dot is in the green: the boat is pushed to the left.
Shifting the beat is how you steer.

stages.name: Right
hint: The green has moved to the right. The wind gets there a quarter turn later.
Raise the sail later, while the dot is in the green.

done: That is all there is to sailing here. Press 1 for the first course.
